'''JohnsonJedi The Executor Execution Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[JohnsonJedi]]
* '''Published:''' 8 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Docking Bay 94|Premiere-L-tatooinedockingbay94.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 Tatooine Docking Bay 94 JohnsonJedi.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Most light space decks are meant to:

A)destroy the Death Star or

B)destroy the Death Star II

this one destroyes the star destroyer of all star destroyers...The Executor!(this deck defeats the Executor without attrition)

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

The main point is to get Kin Kian in the Blue Squadron 5 with a targeting computer and 2 intuder missles.If you add steady aim it is a for sure thing you'll blow it to pieces!You have to fire at the Executor before you do this though.Look at the math.

Blue Squadron 5 adds 2 to each weapon destiny.That makes 4 so for.

Kin Kian does the same thing making 8.

The Intruder Missles adds a total of 6 making 14(the Executor has an armor of 12).The targeting computer subtracts 1 making 13.Add staedy aim and you can have a total of 15 or 17 without even drawing weapon destiny.
